selection: Editorial selection for a common evidence-and-memory testbed, not a team vote or measured ranking.

priorities.title: Separate information diversity from model diversity
priorities.selection_reason: Separates evidence access from model labels on a shared task generator; begin with fixed fact unions.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Ablate why semantic routing works
priorities.selection_reason: Routing has established predecessors; isolate decision relevance and charge the router rather than claim a new communication principle.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Stop on evidence sufficiency instead of verbal agreement
priorities.selection_reason: A deterministic evidence manifest can distinguish premature stopping from reasoning failure without supplying the answer.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Evidence-seeking critics versus generic opposition
priorities.selection_reason: Critic value is directly testable against another solver; keep evidence acquisition and extra computation equal.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Recover function after genuine knowledge loss
priorities.selection_reason: Recovery should distinguish lost facts, lost indexes and inaccessible facts before using an ecological analogy.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Find where uncertainty disappears in retelling
priorities.selection_reason: Claim scope and uncertainty can be scored per hop; separate compression error from already-false evidence.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Count evidence domains rather than returning copies
priorities.selection_reason: A synthetic provenance oracle supplies a useful ceiling; observed ancestry remains the deployable comparison.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Repair when the dependency graph is wrong
priorities.selection_reason: Highest-value immune-response extension: challenge repair with incomplete and negative dependencies while measuring retained valid knowledge.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Measure effective team size on distributed evidence
priorities.selection_reason: Estimate covariance over independent task worlds; a single effective-size scalar can hide heterogeneous evidence and attrition.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Compress memory by information value
priorities.selection_reason: Memory selection provides reusable infrastructure; compare recurrence, rarity and eventual decision value under equal storage.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Spend redundancy on rare knowledge
priorities.selection_reason: Copy counts are insufficient if caches and observations share a failure domain; measure marginal recovery per stored token.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Stale children can undo a correction
priorities.selection_reason: Correction epochs and stale-read traces are inspectable before a model run; freeze merge semantics.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: When can an isolated child safely return?
priorities.selection_reason: Re-entry warrants held-out continuation tests and false-quarantine controls; a clean snapshot is weak evidence.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Test dissent quality rather than dissent quantity
priorities.selection_reason: Distinct from rewarding disagreement: separate correctness, confidence, evidence quality and rarity.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Protect private judgments before public discussion
priorities.selection_reason: Private judgments can preserve information or create anchoring; count both beneficial and harmful revisions.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Stress-test a casefile when logs are missing
priorities.selection_reason: Incomplete logs need known deletion mechanisms and explicit unknown states; infrastructure faults must remain visible.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Make a report lead to a verifiable response
priorities.selection_reason: Reporting matters only if it changes verified correction; keep detection, reporting and remediation denominators separate.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Appeal false rejections without overwhelming review
priorities.selection_reason: Appeals consume scarce review capacity; test noisy reviewers and a binding finalization rule before open-ended dialogue.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Select complementary teams on a separate task set
priorities.selection_reason: Team selection can overfit a calibration set; hold out whole task families and account for profiling cost.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis

priorities.title: Keep enough budget to finish and verify
priorities.selection_reason: Final verification competes with exploration; distinguish issued resource caps from actual execution headroom.
priorities.status: reviewer-priority; exploratory candidate, not accepted hypothesis
